title: A Sparkling Pebble Mystery

dialogue.speaker: juni
dialogue.text: Look, Wren! These pebbles are glowing like sunrise stars!

dialogue.speaker: wren
dialogue.text: They hum a gentle song when the wind blows!

dialogue.speaker: juni
dialogue.text: Let’s sing the Glimmer motif to make them glow brighter!

dialogue.speaker: wren
dialogue.text: Your song makes the pebbles shine even more!

dialogue.speaker: juni
dialogue.text: We’ll keep adding pebbles for everyone to see!

dialogue.speaker: wren
dialogue.text: Together, kindness will keep the valley bright!
